content.rendered:
May 9th Surprise Sixteen Birthday DJ Party – Orinda
A fun Night and they were serving Grilled Hot Dogs for the kids around the swimming pool.
Then fun dancing for the Entire Night.
Happy Sweet 16 Birthday !.
